name: GroundTruth – return path / EMI analysis
description: Finds return-path problems (plane gaps, missing stitching vias, detours) on high-speed nets, solves the return current in the reference plane and estimates the radiated emission.

actions.name: Analyse return paths
actions.description: Open the GroundTruth window: part models, nets, rule checks, field solver and heatmaps

actions.name: Add selected net to GroundTruth
actions.description: Add the net of the selected track, via or pad to the GroundTruth Nets table (select it first by clicking or right-clicking it); opens the window if needed

actions.name: Clear GT markers
actions.description: Remove all markers, contours and arrows GroundTruth drew on the board (one undo step)
